During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], two [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] soldiers, [[Felix Iresso]] and [[Milo Pellam]], undertook a '''scouting mission''' to the planet [[Althir III]]. There, they were captured by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] strike team. Chosen as test subjects for [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ouzal]], the two were implanted with the information contained within a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] into their brain. Pelam was completely broken by the procedure, while Iresso escaped on his own, only losing a portion of his memory.
